title: ExecGuard audit event
description: One line of /var/log/execguard/audit.jsonl, written by audit_write() in src/userspace/execguard.c from a struct eg_event (src/include/execguard/eg_common.h) received over the BPF ring buffer. One event is emitted for every decision on a protected inode; operations on unprotected files are never logged.

ts_ns.description: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds at decision time (bpf_ktime_get_ns). Not wall-clock time.

decision.description: enum eg_decision. AUDIT means the operation would have been denied but global audit-only mode is active.

op.description: enum eg_op. WRITE covers every write-intent open (write, append, O_TRUNC).

uid.description: Real UID of the acting task.

pid.description: Kernel PID (thread ID) of the acting task.

tgid.description: Kernel TGID (userspace process ID) of the acting task.

target_name.description: Best-effort dentry name captured in-kernel. For a rename-over this is the destination name.

target_path.description: Configured path for (target_dev, target_ino), resolved by the daemon. Empty if the inode is no longer in the daemon's mirror.

caller_dev.description: Device of the acting task's executable image (mm->exe_file). 0 for kernel threads.

caller_ino.description: Inode of the acting task's executable image. This is the identity checked against trusted_exes.
